title: Practice 8: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: В 1977 году Фадиль перешёл в ___ (мусульманство, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Fadil converted to Islam in 1977.
exercises.why: **мусульманство → мусульманство** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. мусульманство · мусульманства · мусульманству · мусульманство · мусульманством · мусульманстве; pl. мусульманства · мусульманств · мусульманствам · мусульманства · мусульманствами · мусульманствах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том дал нам разрешение на ___ (выезд, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom gave us permission to leave.
exercises.why: **выезд → выезд** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. выезд · выезда · выезду · выезд · выездом · выезде; pl. выезды · выездов · выездам · выезды · выездами · выездах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Как ты научился так хорошо играть в ___ (нарды, acc. pl.)?
exercises.prompt: How did you get so good at backgammon?
exercises.why: **нарды → нарды** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural нарды. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): нарды · нардов · нардам · нарды · нардами · нардах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том сел на ___ (складной стул, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom sat down on a folding chair.
exercises.why: **стул → стул** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **складной → складной** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with стул). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. стул · стула · стулу · стул · стулом · стуле; pl. стулы · стулов · стулам · стулы · стулами · стулах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Соседи превратили свой балкон в ___ (настоящая оранжерея, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The neighbours made their balcony into a proper greenhouse.
exercises.why: **оранжерея → оранжерею** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  **настоящий → настоящую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with оранжерею). Adjective type IV, sibilant (after ж, ч, ш, щ) — declines like DLI's хороший (every form has the same endings): A. хорошую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. оранжерея · оранжереи · оранжерее · оранжерею · оранжереей · оранжерее; pl. оранжереи · оранжерей · оранжереям · оранжереи · оранжереями · оранжереях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Технологическую инструкцию на ___ (теплообменник, acc. sg.) вы можете загрузить здесь.
exercises.prompt: You can download the instruction manual for the heat exchanger here.
exercises.why: **теплообменник → теплообменник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. теплообменник · теплообменника · теплообменнику · теплообменник · теплообменником · теплообменнике; pl. теплообменники · теплообменников · теплообменникам · теплообменники · теплообменниками · теплообменниках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Двое из них преобразовали химию в ___ (современная наука, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The two of them transformed chemistry into a modern science.
exercises.why: **наука → науку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **современный → современную** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with науку). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. наука · науки · науке · науку · наукой · науке; pl. науки · наук · наукам · науки · науками · науках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он часто действовал без оглядки на ___ (чувство, acc. pl.) других людей.
exercises.prompt: He often acted without regard to the feelings of others.
exercises.why: **чувство → чувства** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural чувства. Declines like DLI's окно — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. окна). Ending -о → -а.  Declension: sg. чувство · чувства · чувству · чувство · чувством · чувстве; pl. чувства · чувств · чувствам · чувства · чувствами · чувствах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Коридорный проводит вас в ___ (ваш номер, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The bellboy will show you to your room.
exercises.why: **номер → номер** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **ваш → ваш** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with номер). A possessive — declines like DLI's наш. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. номер · номера · номеру · номер · номером · номере; pl. номера · номеров · номерам · номера · номерами · номерах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: У Тома аллергия на ___ (латекс, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom is allergic to latex.
exercises.why: **латекс → латекс** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). Declension: sg. латекс · латекса · латексу · латекс · латексом · латексе; pl. латексы · латексов · латексам · латексы · латексами · латексах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. exercises.q: Чтобы справиться с депрессией, Мэри с головой окунулась в ___ (работа, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: To cope with her depression, Mary threw herself into her work.
exercises.why: **работа → работу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. работа · работы · работе · работу · работой · работе; pl. работы · работ · работам · работы · работами · работах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (посул, acc. pl.) тароват, а на деле скуповат.
exercises.prompt: The greatest talkers are the least doers.
exercises.why: **посул → посулы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural посулы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  Declension: sg. посул · посула · посулу · посул · посулом · посуле; pl. посулы · посулов · посулам · посулы · посулами · посулах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том накричал на ___ (официант, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom yelled at the waiter.
exercises.why: **официант → официанта** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). exercises.q: Они все сильны в беге на ___ (короткая дистанция, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: They're all great sprinters.
exercises.why: **дистанция → дистанцию** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ия. Declines like DLI's армия — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  **короткий → короткую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with дистанцию). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. дистанция · дистанции · дистанции · дистанцию · дистанцией · дистанции; pl. дистанции · дистанций · дистанциям · дистанции · дистанциями · дистанциях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Поездки на ___ (остров, acc. pl.) стоят недёшево.
